Make a separate application for each post you wish to apply for.
Pay the non-refundable fee of Rs. 590/- (Incl. of all Taxes) for each application through online transfer/UPI/NEFT to the University bank account given below.

Valid documentary proof of any change of name (if applicable), such as a Marriage Certificate, Gazette Notification or Aadhaar Card.
All documents must be properly indexed, serially numbered and self-attested.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: NFSU Varanasi has advertised 2 non-teaching positions, both in the Administration department.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Both posts are filled by direct appointment. Qualifications and experience are counted as on the last date of submission of the application. Essential qualifications / criteria: Minimum qualification: Graduate in any discipline with 60% marks or equivalent grade as per the UGC approved grading system. Experience of 15 years, out of which at least 8 years should be on the position of Deputy Registrar or equivalent at Pay Level 13. Should be well-versed with the rules and regulations of Govt of India/ Govt Autonomous bodies in matters related to Administration, Establishment, Finance & Accounts, Recruitment, Legal Matters, Procurement etc. Desirable qualification: Working knowledge of computer applications. Excellent communication skills and ability to undertake coordination tasks with state Govt and other concerned stakeholders. Knowledge of legal matters and ability to render advice to competent authority as and when required. Preference will be given to candidates with previous experience of administrative work in a Govt/Autonomous/Defense establishment. Essential qualifications / criteria: Graduation in any subject from a reputed institution, with a good academic record. 03 years' experience as an Administrative Assistant or equivalent post in an educational Institute or Government/Private office. Excellent communication skills in Hindi and English are essential. Knowledge and proficient in MS Office and Tally Prime and Computer applications. Desirable qualification/experience: Post-Graduation in any subject from a reputed institution, with a good academic record. Preference will be given to candidates having previous experience of working in a Government Educational Institute. The prescribed essential qualifications are a bare minimum; holding them does not by itself entitle a candidate to be considered. Candidates should give all qualifications and experience they have in the relevant field. Where grading or any system other than percentage is followed, the result must be converted into a percentage using the conversion table declared by the concerned university. Candidates holding degrees, diplomas or certificates from institutions declared fake or derecognized by the University Grants Commission, New Delhi, are not eligible. The University may relax qualifications, experience or age criteria at its discretion. The full eligibility of each post is given in the official notification.

rows.maximum_age: Should not be more than 64 years as on the closing date of application
rows.experience: 15 years, of which at least 8 years on the position of Deputy Registrar or equivalent at Pay Level 13
03 years as an Administrative Assistant or equivalent post in an educational Institute or Government/Private office

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Both posts carry a consolidated monthly remuneration: Rs. 90,000/- for the Officer on Special Duty and Rs. 44,900/- for the Office Superintendent. The posts are purely temporary and on a contractual basis for 11 months, which may be extended based on performance and institutional requirements, or until a regular incumbent is appointed, whichever is earlier. The terms and conditions of appointment will be communicated through an "Offer of Appointment"; if the offer is not accepted within the stipulated time, it is withdrawn automatically. Appointment is subject to the candidate being in sound mental and physical health.

content_sections.heading: NFSU Varanasi Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: During the period of engagement, the Officer on Special Duty is expected to oversee the administrative functions and provide effective assistance to the competent authority of NFSU Varanasi Campus.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NFSU Varanasi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the online application form for non-teaching posts at https://forms.gle/ooFALsPhmVrt3VK18 (linked under Important Links below) between 23/11/2026 and 30/11/2026 till midnight. Make a separate application for each post you wish to apply for. Pay the non-refundable fee of Rs. 590/- (Incl. of all Taxes) for each application through online transfer/UPI/NEFT to the University bank account given below. Enter the fee transaction details in the online form and submit it. Give a correct email address, since all communication to eligible candidates is made by email only and the University is not responsible for loss of communication due to incorrect email details. The fee is the same for all candidates. Only candidates who applied through the online link and are eligible will be allowed to appear in the interview. All original documents related to educational qualifications, experience and other relevant credentials, to be produced at the interview; candidature is cancelled if they are not produced. One set of all relevant documents and certificates, to be submitted at the interview. No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the employer, for candidates presently in service under the Central/State Government, Semi-Government organizations or Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs), at the interview. Valid documentary proof of any change of name (if applicable), such as a Marriage Certificate, Gazette Notification or Aadhaar Card. All documents must be properly indexed, serially numbered and self-attested.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The mode of selection for both posts is interview only. In the case of a large number of applications, the University may conduct a screening/skill test to shortlist candidates, followed by an interview. The interview will be held in offline mode only at the National Forensic Sciences University, Varanasi Campus; requests for online interviews will not be entertained. A change of venue, if any, will be intimated. The date of the interview/skill test will be communicated to shortlisted candidates separately. Candidates are allowed before the interview panel subject to their eligibility, and it is the candidate's responsibility to ensure eligibility before appearing. Depending on the number of candidates, interviews may go till late in the day or may be held on the next day; candidates must make their arrangements accordingly. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NFSU Varanasi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 01 Officer on Special Duty and 01 Office Superintendent, both in the Administration department of NFSU Varanasi Campus.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NFSU Varanasi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date of online application is 30/11/2026 till midnight; the online application started on 23/11/2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the NFSU Office Superintendent post?
faq.answer: Graduation in any subject from a reputed institution with a good academic record, 03 years' experience as an Administrative Assistant or equivalent post, excellent Hindi and English communication skills, and proficiency in MS Office, Tally Prime and computer applications.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required for the NFSU Officer on Special Duty post?
faq.answer: Graduate in any discipline with 60% marks or equivalent grade, with 15 years' experience of which at least 8 years should be as Deputy Registrar or equivalent at Pay Level 13, and knowledge of Government of India rules in administration, finance, recruitment, legal and procurement matters.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for NFSU Varanasi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The Officer on Special Duty should not be more than 64 years as on the closing date of application, and the maximum age for the Office Superintendent is 40 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for NFSU Varanasi posts?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly remuneration is Rs. 90,000/- for the Officer on Special Duty and Rs. 44,900/- for the Office Superintendent.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for NFSU Varanasi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 590/- (Incl. of all Taxes) for all candidates, non-refundable, paid by online transfer/UPI/NEFT, with the transaction details entered in the online form.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for the NFSU Varanasi posts?
faq.answer: Selection is by interview only, held offline at NFSU Varanasi Campus; if applications are large in number, the University may hold a screening/skill test to shortlist candidates before the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for both NFSU Varanasi posts?
faq.answer: Separate applications are to be made for each post, each with the Rs. 590/- fee.

faq.question: Q10. Are the NFSU Varanasi posts permanent?
faq.answer: No. The posts are purely temporary and contractual for 11 months, which may be extended based on performance and institutional requirements, or until a regular incumbent is appointed, whichever is earlier.
